vinyl.title: Raw As F**k
vinyl.label: Against The Grain
vinyl.note_en: Title track of Freestylers' third album (2004), the first full-length release on Against The Grain — Aston Harvey & Matt Cantor's own label — and a cornerstone of UK big-beat / nu skool breaks alongside the Plump DJs and Krafty Kuts era.
vinyl.note_es: Tema que da título al tercer álbum de Freestylers (2004), primer largo publicado en Against The Grain —sello propio de Aston Harvey y Matt Cantor— y piedra angular del big-beat / nu-skool breaks británico junto a Plump DJs y Krafty Kuts.

vinyl.title: Sousounde
vinyl.label: Dioula
vinyl.note_en: A2 cut of the 1999 Dioula 12" (JAZZREG 01) that also carried 4 Hero and DJ Cam remixes — Freq Nasty & B.L.I.M. flipping Métisse's Afro-tinged original into a heavyweight UK nu skool breaks weapon.
vinyl.note_es: Cara A2 del 12" de Dioula (JAZZREG 01, 1999), que además traía remixes de 4 Hero y DJ Cam: Freq Nasty y B.L.I.M. llevan el original afro de Métisse al terreno del nu-skool breaks británico más contundente.

vinyl.title: The Highs And Lows
vinyl.label: Botchit & Scarper
vinyl.note_en: A-side of the 2002 Botchit & Scarper compilation Botchit Breaks 5 (Part 1) — Atomic Hooligan (Matt Welch & Terry Ryan) delivering peak nu skool breaks on Rennie Pilgrem's label, alongside Mindmuggaz, Si Begg and LBJ.
vinyl.note_es: Cara A del recopilatorio Botchit Breaks 5 (Part 1) de Botchit & Scarper (2002) — Atomic Hooligan (Matt Welch y Terry Ryan) en pleno momento nu-skool breaks, en el sello de Rennie Pilgrem junto a Mindmuggaz, Si Begg y LBJ.

vinyl.title: Under The Sky
vinyl.label: Break Beat Boom Records
vinyl.note_en: B-side of the 2 Revive 12" on Break Beat Boom Records (Spain, 2002) — Rafael Ortiz Jurado aka Mr. Fli, one of the defining Spanish nu skool breaks producers of the early 2000s (also featured on the Beat Dis! 2003 compilation on Reflex Musik).
vinyl.note_es: Cara B del 12" 2 Revive en Break Beat Boom Records (España, 2002) — Rafael Ortiz Jurado alias Mr. Fli, uno de los productores clave del nu-skool breaks español de principios de los 2000 (también presente en el recopilatorio Beat Dis! 2003 de Reflex Musik).

vinyl.title: They Call It Flip Flop
vinyl.label: Crisp Biscuit
vinyl.note_en: B-side of the 2007 Crisp Biscuit 12" (CB-09) — an unofficial white-label paired with Cut & Run's Street Life edit. They Call It Flip Flop is the duo's breakbeat rework of Dead Prez's It's Bigger Than Hip Hop, a staple in the A.Skillz / Krafty Kuts / Stanton Warriors booty-breaks era.
vinyl.note_es: Cara B del 12" de Crisp Biscuit (CB-09, 2007) — white label no oficial emparejado con el edit Street Life de Cut & Run. They Call It Flip Flop es su reelaboración breakbeat de It's Bigger Than Hip Hop de Dead Prez, un clásico de la era booty-breaks (A.Skillz, Krafty Kuts, Stanton Warriors).
